Season 3

1 story

One story in two parts: the true, ridiculous mission of the Nazi spy who parachuted into neutral Ireland.

  • Yarn 19 / 1h 16m / Jun 2020

    How Not to Be a Spy

    For our third season we focus on one story in this two part Docu-Drama. The true story of Hermann Goertz, the Nazi spy who landed in neutral Ireland during the Second World War, on a mission to meet the IRA and organise a German-led invasion of Northern Ireland.

About Yarn

We have 29 different stories now, each in a different style. Most episodes are standalone but some bigger stories are part of a series.

We've done a 3-part doc series on the history of disability, a 2-part docu-drama about a Nazi spy in Ireland during WW2. We've taken listeners on a trip around the Chernobyl exclusion zone, on a ride-along with a New York police officer and into the bizarre palace of a corrupt dictator.

Produced and presented by John Roche in Dublin, Ireland since 2017.
